headline: Chris asked for the frozen engine tests on the nudge version used by the phase-diagram loops. A two-minute Hatteras job ran them: 74 of 74 passed, as did main's engine in the same job, so every item asked of this line is done and it is ready for Chris to close. The run also corrected the Nov 23 records the checker challenged (the older nudge had passed these tests on Nov 6 and 7; the energy audit is shown clean only for the two runs rerun after the fix), and put the nudge branch back on this machine.

experiments.question: Does the nudge version with the energy-total fix, the one the phase-diagram loops run, still pass the frozen engine tests?
experiments.what_was_done: A single short job on the cluster took that exact version from the copy of the code the cluster kept from earlier jobs, and ran the program's fixed set of seventy-four engine tests against it, the same way as on Nov 7, with the main engine tested alongside as a control. The job also sent back a packed copy of the nudge branch.
experiments.result: All seventy-four tests passed for the nudge, and all seventy-four for the main engine. The printed import path confirms the nudge's own engine was the one tested. The packed branch was unpacked here, so the nudge code is on this machine again.
experiments.takeaway: Both nudge versions the program has used pass the frozen tests. Nothing Chris asked of this line is left; it can close.
